name: BITEZ Gummies 10,000MG Jarz - Delta-8 + Delta-9 + THCP - Galactic Punch
description: Blast off with Double-Stacked Galactic Punch BITEZ. These dual-layer gummies fuse deep, velvety blackberry with a vibrant, classic fruit punch finish for a sweet, juicy flavor that’s anything but ordinary. Each double-stacked gummy packs a powerful 1,000mg Delta-8, Delta-9, and THCP blend (10 gummies per jar, 10,000mg total). A cosmic collision of dark berry and punchy fruit built for the heavy hitter.
